subject.title: Feature Request: Surface API provider name in error/overload messages

question: Which transient diagnostic fields should be delivered in user-visible channel replies when fixing this issue?
rationale: The issue asks for provider name, while the active PR expands delivered text to provider/model/profile-presence/trigger; that privacy and UX boundary needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Deliver provider/model only
options.body: User-visible replies identify the active provider and model while profile, session, trigger, and request identifiers stay in logs or lifecycle metadata.

options.title: Accept broader context
options.body: Allow profile presence and trigger in replies after refreshed transport proof confirms raw profile, session, and provider request identifiers remain hidden.

options.title: Keep details log-only
options.body: Leave channel replies generic and add provider context only to logs, which is safer but does not fully solve the reported user ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Deliver provider/model only
recommendation.body: User-visible replies identify the active provider and model while profile, session, trigger, and request identifiers stay in logs or lifecycle metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work owns the extracted formatter path where this user-visible boundary must be resolved.
